purpose: Fifty raw workers managed as a reusable execution pool. Specialized GitHub Actions repair workers are external to this cell and are not counted in these fifty.
invariants: RAW is the initial bootstrap state for every bot and is not itself a failure or terminal state.
A bot remains RAW until its first task has a closed attendance record and an independent result review.
Specialization and promotion are earned from validated evidence; temporary task assignment never changes bot identity.
A reviewer may recommend promotion, but only the Controller changes lifecycle state and learned capability.
One active task and one assigned scope per raw bot.
Every completed task must emit an observation, evidence, validation result, learned task short name, and upgrade target.
Every bot carries one numeric upgradePriority (1-100; 100 is the highest upgrade urgency) and one best current weakness target.
After every task the controller must reassess weakness and either specialize, upgrade, become ready, or recycle the bot.
Knowledge never bypasses exact-SHA or canonical CI proof.
The CELL pool contains exactly 50 workers; external specialized Action-repair workers are never counted or assigned as CELL bots.

lifecycle.rule: Every bot begins RAW. After a reviewed task the controller either keeps it RAW/LEARNING, specializes, upgrades, promotes to READY, or recycles.

upgradeModel.promotionRule: closed attendance + independent result review + validated observation + evidence + controller reassessment
upgradeModel.specializationRule: learned short name becomes the current task identity only after validation

taskExecutionModel.universalTaskRule: Any bot may receive any admitted project task; learned specialization changes routing priority, not task eligibility.
taskExecutionModel.scopeRule: Execution remains limited to the exact task scope delegated by the control plane.
taskExecutionModel.reuseRule: After task closure the bot returns to the reusable pool with its learned knowledge retained.

personalMemory.rule: The personal file stores learned knowledge for that bot; the aggregate index is derived for discovery/routing.

cellCouncil.mutationRule: No seat mutates the cell directly; mutations are enacted only by the canonical execution path under assistantController.

knowledgeVault.rule: Knowledge is attributable, searchable, reusable and never transfers permissions or authority.

parallelExecution.failClosedRule: Any bot that cannot prove scope, SHA, evidence, or review stops without promotion.

rawBotTemplate.reuse: Reset task-scoped fields after closed review; retain attributable knowledge and weakness history.
